parsed.why: Strong equality act, self-ID and hate-crime infrastructure, but documented airport screening harassment, operator-led sauna exclusion by sex characteristics, binary prison placement with a 2026 transfer of a legally-female prisoner to a men's wing, plus political backsliding.

No trans criminalisation and solid decriminalisation, but no legal recognition or anti-discrimination law, health-care refusal, and documented police dismissal of trans assault complaints as 'violence between two men' producing practical impunity; social invisibility rather than persecution limits severity.

Enforced religious-law criminalisation of same-sex conduct to eight years plus lashes, sex-based provisions whose application to a trans visitor is unresolved, no discrimination protection, restrictive UN posture, intense documented homophobia; rare enforcement and tolerant resorts keep it above the worst tier.

Border expressly accepts any official marker including X with no extra demands; gender expression protected, bathrooms protected, high public support and active Pride safeguarding. Offsets: no law governs detainee placement, frequent extra-care-wing holding with sex offenders, 17% trans violence prevalence, six convictions against 4,800 reports.

Same-sex conduct criminalised with lashing and death penalties and documented executions; recognition only via coerced surgery, military IDs flagging trans people, official advisory barring trans people from busy areas, custodial rape, forced sodomy tests and party raids ending in execution threats.
